Black Eye Peak

At the heart of these treacherous mountains lies the mouth of an ancient volcano. Its days of activity are long forgotten, now it's completely frozen over. The dark pit feels disturbingly inviting.

Black Eye Peak is a location that can be found in the Jarvonia region.

Keyword

The following keywords apply to this location.

Snowy

Faction

Black Eye Peak is a member of the following factions:

Jarvonia

Activities

The following activities always available at this location.

Ridge scrambling
Mine farganite ore
Spelunking

Routes

The following routes are available at this location.

  Sanguine Hills 
1300 Base Steps
 Black Eye Peak 
  Winter's End 
565 Base Steps

Trivia

  • Black Eye Peak is incredibly dangerous, and thus the source of Unidentified remains sometimes found by the Rescue team. Any 'fine' remains are that of potential VIPs.
